title: Locating the Elysian Fields dance halls and Pete Fountain's place
summary: They try to place the dance hall; upstairs halls with galleries, and Pete's club on Royal Street, are discussed.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: To get back to Lesion Fields, I know it's a little bit on the way. Do you remember the corner about that dance hall?
Or the name of the dance hall?
It was probably Burgundy Street. It wasn't where Pete was. Pete was on Royal. He was at Lusitannis, huh? He was on Royal Street.
Yeah, that's the old Lusitannis, isn't it? I don't know.
I can't remember. Pete completely renovated the whole thing. Yeah. He renovated the whole thing.
And, uh, do you remember the name of that dance hall on the Lesion Fields?

No, there was a lot of them down there, around there. They were all upstairs. There was a big open floor on the second floor. And they used to have like a balcony outside. And you'd go outside and you'd play on the balcony and people would know that you were there. And they could hear you and a little lady, 50 cents or something like that, to come over there and dance for a half a buck or a buck all night. Uh-huh. And, uh, no, I don't remember just where it was. It was not where Pete was, but because Pete didn't have a gallery on his place. But it was one of the places, it was a corner place, and it had a gallery. And, uh, we were talking about Lesion Fields.
Which Pete are we talking about when you say Pete? Pete Fonten. Pete Fonten, okay.
